description: This Java class implements the ScorecardReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve and update scorecard data from a database, including mapping database rows to data objects and executing SQL queries based on survey and client identifiers.

classes.name: ScorecardMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to ScorecardData objects.

classes.name: ScorecardValueMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to ScorecardValue objects.

methods.name: getScorecardValueBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ScorecardValue objects for a given survey and client from the database.

methods.name: updateScorecardValues
methods.description: Updates a collection of ScorecardData objects by fetching and setting their associated scorecard values.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardBySurvey
methods.description: Retrieves scorecard data for a specific survey, including associated scorecard values.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardByClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecard data for a specific client, including associated scorecard values.

methods.name: retrieveScorecardBySurveyAndClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecard data for a specific survey and client combination, including associated scorecard values.
